invented.quote: Every account reconciled and categorized, with a clear report showing where your money went.
invented.why: The brief only states that the bookkeeper does "monthly books" and does not specify reconciling every account or providing a report.

invented.quote: Paid correctly and on time, tips included.
invented.why: The brief only states "payroll for up to 10 staff" and does not specify that tips are included in payroll.

invented.quote: including ones who had been with me for years.
invented.why: The brief says the price was raised for "existing clients," not that clients had been with the bookkeeper for years.

invented.quote: There are no introductory deals and no surprise increases for new clients.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a policy regarding introductory deals or future price increases for new clients.
